halide_comparison.discovery_method: HALIDE records B&H product IDs (pn) and uses the public B&H image CDN via https://static.bhphoto.com/images/fb/<id>.jpg (or a recorded images2500x2500/<slug>_<id>.jpg URL). It does not scrape the B&H HTML product page.
halide_comparison.access_finding: B&H HTML pages return HTTP 403 / Cloudflare, but static.bhphoto.com image responses return HTTP 200 without a Cloudflare challenge.
halide_comparison.authorization_finding: B&H User Agreement reserves the site content and states that B&H does not authorize use of copyrighted material for any purpose, including non-commercial applications. Technical accessibility is not permission to republish.
halide_comparison.lekha_decision: Use B&H IDs and CDN URLs for exact-model verification and candidate records only. Do not publish B&H images without written permission.
